description: A fictional stylised low-poly video-game prop: a long shoulder tube with a big cone-shaped nose piece, a chunky toy-like cartoon 3D game asset (not a real object, no working parts). A long thick dark grey tube, round in section, with a raised dark grey ring round its front end and a wide flared cone-shaped funnel at its rear end, the funnel much wider than the tube. Out of the front of the tube sticks a fat matte black double-cone nose piece, wider than the tube, ending in a short pointed tip. Under the middle of the tube a matte black handle raked backward with a small curved dark grey lever inside a rounded dark grey loop, and in front of it a second matte black straight vertical handle with ribbed grooves. On top of the tube above the handles a boxy matte black viewer box on a short bracket, with a flat dark blue square window in its front face and a short round stub at its back. A small thin upright black post with a forked top on top of the tube just behind the front ring. A matte black wedge-shaped rest pad on the underside of the tube behind the handles. Bright orange accents: a band round the nose piece at its widest point, the pointed tip of the nose piece, and a band round the rim of the rear funnel. The right flank is plain.
proportions: About 1.30 m long, 0.16 m wide and 0.32 m tall. (length : width : height = 8.13 : 1 : 2.00)
sides: the prop is symmetric left to right; both flanks of the tube are plain.

faces.side: The prop is level: the tube exactly horizontal, the pointed orange tip at the left end of the image, the wide funnel with its orange rim at the right end; the viewer box and the small upright post on top, the two handles and the rest pad hanging below.
faces.front: Seen from the front end everything is concentric circles on one centre line: the small orange tip in the centre, the round matte black nose piece with its orange band as a ring round it, and the bigger round outline of the rear funnel behind it; the viewer box with its dark blue square window stands above the circles and the small upright post in front of it; the two handles hang below on the centre line, one behind the other.
faces.rear: Seen from the rear end: the big round open funnel with its orange rim ring in front of everything, a dark round hole in its centre; the top of the viewer box with its short round stub shows above the funnel; the lower ends of the handles show below it on the centre line. No blue window in this view.
faces.top: Seen from above the prop is a long strip: the pointed tip and the double-cone nose piece with its orange band at the left end, the ring, the long tube, the viewer box as a small rectangle on the centre line, and the funnel widening to its orange rim at the right end; the handles and the rest pad are hidden under the tube.
